config.music_tweaks.title: Mini Music Tweaks Config
config.music_tweaks.enabled.tooltip: Toggle the dynamic combat music feature on or off.
config.music_tweaks.min_pursuit_entities: The minimum amount of hostile mobs that must be nearby to trigger combat music.
config.music_tweaks.decay_time.tooltip: How long combat music will continue playing after no hostile mobs are nearby.
config.music_tweaks.sounds.tooltip: List of SoundEvent Resource Locations that can be chosen for combat music.
config.music_tweaks.music_frequency.tool: Controls how often vanilla background music plays. Default is normal.
config.music_tweaks.show_music_toast.too: Displays a popup toast in the top right when a music track or disc starts playing.
config.music_tweaks.mono_jukeboxes.toolt: Makes jukebox and record player audio non-positional, fixing the annoying panning effect when not facing the jukebox directly.
config.music_tweaks.jukebox_fade_out.too: Fades out background music when near a playing jukebox.
config.music_tweaks.jukebox_distance.too: The radius in blocks around a jukebox that will fade out background music.
